facts.text: Jolene achieved a major milestone last week that she described as a significant accomplishment as an engineer.

evidence.quote: I had a major milestone last week and it went really well - I'm so relieved and proud. It was a huge accomplishment for me as an engineer.

facts.text: Jolene designed and built a sustainable water purifier for a rural community in need, which required extensive planning and research.

evidence.quote: I had to plan and research a lot to design and build a sustainable water purifier for a rural community in need.

facts.text: Jolene expressed that seeing the water purifier working and providing clean water to the community was incredibly satisfying.

evidence.quote: Seeing it working and providing clean water to the community was incredibly satisfying.

facts.text: Jolene felt that her engineering skills made a difference for people in a rural area, which reminded her of the impact engineering can have on people's lives.

evidence.quote: Your engineering skills really made a difference for people in a rural area. That's amazing!
It reminded me of how engineering can make a difference in people's lives.
